text: Artificial intelligence is changing our world at a rapid pace, but with great power comes great responsibility. One major ethical concern is bias; if AI systems learn from data that contains human prejudices, they can make unfair decisions in areas like hiring or lending. To ensure fairness, developers must carefully check their data and algorithms. Privacy is another key issue, as AI often collects vast amounts of personal information that must be protected. Furthermore, transparency is vital—people need to understand how decisions are made by these systems. Ultimately, responsible AI development means prioritizing human well-being, being open about limitations, and constantly reviewing the impact of technology on society.
